Commentary.Commentary: The bowling was good for Sri Lanka for the most part of the game. Lahiru Gamage led from the front, registering his best figures in ODIs. He was well backed up by the rest as they never allowed the hosts to get away. Thisara Perera chipped in with a vital spell, taking 2/34. The Islanders will back themselves to chase this total but the hosts are not yet out of the game. They have the bowling attack to defend this. Will they do it? Let's see. Join us for the chase in a while.

A commendable effort by Pakistan! They won the toss, elected to bat first but the move almost backfired on them when they were reduced to 101 for 6. The batting was poor against some really disciplined bowling. It was only thanks to a sensible stand between Babar Azam and Shadab Khan that they have managed to post this total on the board. Both batsmen did not repeat the mistakes of the top order who didn't apply themselves on this slow wicket. Azam scored his second ton in as many games and showed his class. He was given really good support by Khan, who chipped in with his maiden fifty.
Length delivery in line of the stumps, Khan backs away and flat-bats it to long on for a run. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 219/9.
Junaid Khan is the last man in for Pakistan.

OUT! Raees holes out! High full toss, Raees heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. Dananjaya lines it up and takes it. The umpires check for the height of the ball. It is below the waist and hence, a legal delivery. Raees has to go back.
Rumman Raees is the new man in.

OUT! Brilliant work, Akila! High full toss on off, Ali miscues his heave over mid-wicket. Dananjaya runs in from the deep and collects it on the bounce. The batsmen go for the second, the fielder fires an accurate throw at the striker's end and hits the bull's eye. It is referred upstairs. Seems to be touch and go. The replays show that Hasan is just short of his crease.
There is a run out appeal against Hasan Ali. It's a direct hit and those are always close. Over to the third umpire now...
SIX! Boom! That came right from the screws! Slower delivery on a length on leg stump, Ali clears his front leg and slogs it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Khan flat-bats this length delivery to mid on for a run.
Hasan Ali comes out to bat.

OUT! End of a terrific knock from Azam! Take a bow, champion! Full toss on off, Azam looks to clear long on but doesn't get it off the meat of the bat. Kusal Mendis near the fence takes an easy catch. Babar gets a rousing applause from the crowd. It can turn out to be a match-winning knock for his side.
Clips the full delivery to the leg side for a run.
Maiden ODI fifty for Shadab Khan! Good stuff, young man! Hits this one to long off for a quick single. The entire Pakistani dressing room is up on its feet.
FOUR! Shot! In the slot, Khan clears his front leg and heaves it over cow corner for a one bounce boundary.
Leg bye! Around the pads, Azam looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball brushes his pad and rolls to short fine leg. They crossed.

There it is! 7th ODI ton for Azam! Back-to-back centuries for him as well. He tucks this length ball towards wide mid on and sets off. Lakmal himself rushes to the ball and till he throws it back, the batsmen complete the second. Babar is absolutely delighted! He has played sensible cricket and constructed his innings really well. Raises his bat skywards to acknowledge the cheers from the crowd.
Around off, smashes to covers for a brisk run. That brings up the 100-run stand. A top, top partnership. It has brought Pakistan right back into the contest.
Full length ball on off, Khan hits it through mid-wicket for a single. Good over from Perera, only 5 from it.
Bowled at 96 kph outside off, Khan goes for an agricultural slog across the line but misses.
Full toss outside off, Shadab slices it to deep cover. The fielder races to his left and keeps it down to a couple.
Play and a miss! Khan moves across his stumps and Perera smartly bowls it full around off. Khan goes through with his paddle scoop but fails to connect.
Another off-cutter on off, quietly nudged to wide mid on for a run.
Slower delivery on off, Khan slogs it to long on to get off strike.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, Babar works it to wide long on for a brace. Moves to 97 with that.

Brilliant bowling. Bowls a pinpoint yorker around the boots, Shadab clears his front leg and places it in front of square on the leg side. The batsmen want the second but the fielder from deep square leg is quick to attack the ball.
Very full outside off, jammed to cover-point for a run.
Good length ball on middle, Khan moves inside the line and tucks it uppishly through backward square leg. A single taken. He is playing sensible cricket.
Angling into the pads, Babar helps it around the corner to rotate strike.
Fullish delivery, Khan makes room and slices it to point. A run taken. He is not happy. Wanted to place it behind the fielder there.
Suranga Lakmal to have a go with the ball again.
Khan backs away to the length delivery and whacks it to sweeper cover for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Perera bowls this one with a slinging action and hits the blockhole. Shadab manages to dig it out besides the pitch on the leg side. The batsmen sneak in a run.
Good stuff from Perera! Bowls an off-cutter in line of the stumps. Khan can only play it back to the bowler.
Fullish delivery on middle, played with soft hands through mid-wicket for a brace.

A loud shout for an LBW denied! On a fullish length on middle and off, Azam looks to clip it away but seems to have got an inside edge towards short fine leg. Perera appeals loudly but the umpire stays put. Signals it as a run. The replays confirm it came right from the bat. Wise to not take the review.
A slight delay. Azam and Khan are taking a bit of a breather. Meanwhile, Perera comes back for a bowl.
Full ball on off, swept to short fine leg for a single. 5 from the over.
On the pads, nudged around the corner for a run.
Uses his feet to knock it down to long on to rotate strike.
Floated outside off, pushed to the left side of the bowler who stops it.
Sloppy work! Fraction short outside off, Khan cuts it to Tharanga at extra cover who lets it go through his legs. Concedes a couple.
Plays this one with the spin to the leg side for a run.
Milks this one to long off for a run. Moves into the nineties with that.
FOUR! Well played! Fuller length ball on off, Azam lifts it over mid on. It is well wide of the fielder who is standing inside the ropes. Beats him to his left to find the fence.
Very full just outside off, Khan hammers it to long on for a run. Lines up for the second but the fielder is quick to attack to the ball to deny the batsmen.
Angling into the hips, Azam stays well balanced to tuck it to short fine leg. A single taken.
Short and width on offer, slapped to deep point for a brace.
Back of a length well outside off, Khan goes at it with hard hands. Wanted to play it straighter but gets it uppishly to extra cover. A run taken.
Uses his feet and taps it to short mid-wicket.
Flicks this one through mid-wicket. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Technically a stumping chance missed! Yorker on leg stump, Khan looks to dig it out but is foxed. Dickwella fails to collect it and the ball deflects off his gloves to short fine leg. A run taken.
Full on middle, clipped with the angle through wide mid on for a run.
Short outside off, Azam cuts it with the spin but straight to the man at extra cover.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Azam paddle scoops it towards fine leg for a run.
Akila Dananjaya is called back into the attack.

Improvisation! Full delivery outside off, Shadab shuffles across, kneels and paddle scoops it just over the man at backward square leg. Two runs taken. Intended to play it a lot finer but will take the result.

Brilliant effort from the skipper. That will lift the morale of the entire side. Full toss on off, Azam creams it towards Tharanga at extra cover again who dives to his left to save a certain boundary.
Full and wider outside off, Azam mistimes his stroke to Tharanga at extra cover who has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Fuller in length outside off, Khan places it to the same region to rotate strike.
Half-volley outside off, driven crisply to deep cover for a run.
Edged! Wide outside off, Khan dances down the track and throws his bat at it but gets it off the bottom half to third man. A run taken.
Lahiru Gamage is back for a bowl.
Lands it outside off on a length, cracked through point for a single. 5 runs off that over, good one for the hosts.
A tad short outside off, punched to covers by Khan.
Good length again outside off, defended watchfully.
Good length around off, worked through mid on for a single.
Taps it in front of covers and takes a single.
A tad short outside off, dabbed down to third man for a couple. Brings up the 50-run stand, they have done just what the doctor has ordered for Pakistan.
Powerplay 3 signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the end of the 50th over.
Babar Azam lunges forward and turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Tapped towards covers for a quick single. 150 up for Pakistan!
Fuller around off and middle, Shadab kneels down and sweeps it through mid-wicket. Lakmal goes to his right in the deep and slides to keep the ball in play. Two runs taken.
Floats it outside off, lofted over wide mid off for a couple of runs. Really good shot, that.
Fuller around middle and leg with a round arm action, Khan looks to turn it through the leg side but is hit on his pads.
Darts it outside off, Babar Azam goes back and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Good length around off, punched through mid on for a single. Just the run off that over.
Another slower full delivery outside off, Babar Azam drives it on the up towards point.
A tad short but closer to the stumps, Azam shapes to cut but is cramped for room.
Azam gets across and pats it back down the wicket. Perera tries to run out Shadab at the bowler's end with a deflection but fails to touch the ball.
Almost! Hurls it outside off on a length, the ball holds up a touch, Azam is early into drive. The ball nearly carries to Tharanga at short extra cover.
Starts with a slower one outside off, Azam comes forward and drives it towards covers.
Thisara Perera is back on. He was really effective in his first spell. Can he get the important breakthrough of Babar Azam?
Three dot in a row. Good over. Shadab looks to work it on the leg side but is caught on the pads. Was angling a bit down so no appeal for an lbw.
Looks to turn it into the gap on the leg side, finds the mid-wicket fielder however.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Another single taken. Quite easy for the batsmen at this point. Tucked away in front of square leg for a run.
Darts it into the pads, the leggie works it off his pads on the leg side for one.
Slider on middle and leg, goes back and works it just wide of mid on for a run.
Milinda Siriwardana is introduced into the attack.
Slower one from Lakmal to end the over, it's flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Bumper around off, Khan sees it early and hence, is able to leave it alone without much trouble.
Full and wide outside off, drives it square on the off side. The man at point dives to his right and manages to get a hand to it. It takes the pace off the ball and hence, only a single is taken.
Bowls it on leg stump, Azam picks it off his pads and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Fullish in length and outside off, driven towards covers. Won't get any run for it though.

Tap and run stuff from Babar and Shadab. This is excellent. Khan drops this with soft hands right beside him on the off side and both batsmen set off. Lakmal rushes to the ball and under arms it to hit the stumps, but Azam is in by then. Nicely done.
Full outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Works it off the pads through the square leg region for a run.
Drags the length back a touch and pitches it outside off, Babar off the back foot punches it to sweeper cover. Single taken.
Looped up leg spinner on middle and leg, Shadab clears his front leg and eases it back down to long off for a single.
Works this to short mid-wicket and takes off for the run. There is a shy at the striker's end but Shadab is well in by then.
FOUR! Poor delivery and it's duly punished by Babar Azam! He receives a loopy, juicy full toss and he crashes it through the gap in the covers. Beats the sweeper with ease and finds the fence.
Drinks are on the field!
Excellent yorker from Lakmal, looks to uproot the leg pole but Khan does well to bring his bat down in time and keep it out.
Short delivery banged in on middle stump, Shadab pulls it away awkwardly. However, he still manages to find the gap in front of square on the leg side and takes two runs.
A leg slip in place now...
Moves inside the line to this length ball around off and using those beautiful wrists of his, places it to deep backward square leg for one.
On middle and leg once more, worked in front of short mid-wicket for nothing.
Straighter in line again, allows Shadab to flick it away on the leg side for a single.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, easy enough for Babar Azam to tuck it to deep square leg for a single.
Suranga Lakmal is back on!
Azam clips this one besides the pitch on the leg side and calls his partner through for a sharp run.
Plays this one against the spin to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Almost sneaked through! Quick and flat on off, Khan goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge besides him. He needs to be careful.
Fullish outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! A boundary after ages! Short delivery down the leg side, Azam pulls it through backward square leg to pick up a boundary. Babar going strong.
Sliding down leg, should have been an easy single but Shadab misses it. Misses his attempted flick as the ball goes off his pads on the leg side.
Googly which Shadab Khan doesn't pick, he flicks it away. It goes off his pads and then falls into the mid-wicket region.
Bit fullish in length, nicely wristed down to long on for a single.
Flicked away on the on side but for no run.
Another one hit down to long on which results in another run.
Moves closer to the flighted ball and wrists it down to long on for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.

7th ODI fifty for Babar Azam! Only positive from this Pakistan innings and he's still carrying on. Knocks it down to long on and gets off strike. Goes without saying, he needs to bat till the end somehow.
Sliding in around off, kept out away on the off side.
Flighted delivery around off, another square drive but this time finds the man at point.
Full again outside off, Babar closes the face a little early and gets a leading edge safely to covers.
Quite full and outside off, Babar Azam with a slightly opened face drives it square through backward point. Third man comes across to cut it off and the batsmen take two.
Kneels forward and across to paddle it down towards fine leg. Two very easy runs taken.
Tossed up, defended back to the bowler.
Gets close to the pitch, doesn't let the ball turn and drives it easily to mid off.
Some turn into Shadab Khan, who hangs back and negotiates with it well.
Coming in on middle and off, turned with the spin on the leg side. One run to the total.
Touch short and outside off, a mistimed cut finds the man at short cover.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on the stumps, Babar comes forward and with bat and pad close together, blocks.
Some flight outside off, drilled through sweeper cover for another run.
Full ball outside off, driven to the cover area.
Short and flat, pitched outside off, pushed into the off side. No run taken.
Quicker one on middle and off, moves inside the line before working it away on the on side for one.
Some air on this occasion, safely guarded out to end the over.
Flat and short, turning in and keeping a bit low too, Babar flicks it off his pads square on the leg side for a single.
Shortens the length on this occasion, allows Khan time to go back and punch it square through point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery again.
Moves a step across to get behind the line and defends.
Googly around off, Shadab from deep inside his crease punches it out off the back foot.
Babar comes ahead to this fuller length ball and keeps it out safely.
Darted full and flat outside off, drilled straight back into the bowler's hand.
Wrong 'un first up to Shadab, the batsman didn't have much clue about that as he gets it off the inner edge to square leg for a single.
Shadab Khan strides out to the middle to bat.

OUT! Another wicket down! Vandersay comes into the attack and Vandersay plucks a wicket. Eating away into the tail now, are Sri Lanka. Lovely tossed up leg break around off, spins in as Wasim prods forward to block. Beats the inside edge of the bat and catches the front pad of the left-hander. Loud shout from the Lankans but nothing from the umpire. After some deliberation, it's taken upstairs and now it's the TV umpire's turn to have his say. He looks at multiple replays which show that all three boxes are ticked and Imad is gone.
The third umpire is looking at it from several angles. Looks like the impact is just in line.
A review against Imad Wasim for an lbw decision is taken upstairs by Sri Lanka. Could be close, Imad could be in trouble. Let's see now...
Speared full and well outside off, was there to be hit and Imad goes for it, drills it hard but finds the diving fielder at short extra cover.
Leg break on middle and off, Babar Azam flicks it against the spin through the mid-wicket area for one run.
Jeffrey Vandersay is back into the attack.
The 100 is up for Pakistan! Comes with another run, this is sensible batting by this pair. Nudged 'round the corner and a comfortable run is taken.
Full outside off, drilled down the ground to long off for a run.
Dropped short and flat, punched through the gap in the covers for another one.
Skidding off the surface and it's coming into Imad Wasim, he does well to bring his bat down in time and work it away on the leg side. Another single.
Gets close to the pitch of the ball with a little shimmy down the track and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Quicker through the air around off, Wasim hangs back and punches it through extra cover for a run.
On middle stump, comfortably worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length in the channel outside off, Imad offers a firm punch past point to get off strike.
Bit straight in line, Babar walks across the line and wrists it in front of square leg for a run.
Good length ball with minimal movement off the deck, turned through mid-wicket for one.
Short of a good length going across the batsman, Imad charges out and can only manage to dab it to point.
Looped up outside off, eased through extra cover for one run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to long on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flat, short and no spin on this occasion, Wasim immediately rocks back and cuts it square through point. Single taken.
Drifting in on middle and off, worked away to mid on off the inner half.

An edge which hasn't carried! Wasim survives. Close call. Akila bowls this slower through the air and floats it on off, there's some slight turn as Imad is forward to defend. The edge is drawn but the ball falls just short of the man at first slip.
Tossed right up there, Imad strides forward and pushes it back down the track to the bowler.
Full again, on off, driven off the inner half towards mid on for a quick single.
Dropped on a good length and outside off, Imad drives it on the up towards mid off. Can't beat the man there so won't get any run.
Full ball from Thisara, driven towards long on for an easy one.
Around off again, kept out from within the crease.
Length delivery, keeps it close to off, Babar stands tall but can only punch it back to Perera who collects it on his followthrough.
Back of a length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Azam punches it down towards mid on but gets no run for it.
Goes on straight with the arm, outside off, dabbed to point off the back foot.
Waits for the ball to turn into him before working it away square on the leg side for an easy run.
Uses his feet well, comes out of his crease and meets the ball at its pitch. Blocks it out well.
Slight hesitation from the batsmen. Babar taps it just wide of Chandimal at short cover. Wants the single but then turns back seeing the fielder get to the ball quickly.
Straight one just outside off, Azam pushes it into the off side.
Floated around off, spinning in, Babar plays with the turn to mid-wicket for nothing.
Good length delivery on off, punched down to long on for a single.
Just back of a length around off, going across, Wasim with an open face dabs it behind point and takes a run.
Outside off on a good length, hit to point but for nothing.
Angling across the left-hander, he flashes at it without any foot movement and ends up getting beaten as a result. Not much carry on this occasion, goes low to Dickwella behind the stumps.
Bit fuller in length, on middle and leg, Imad stays back and keeps it out down the track.
Coming back in on middle and off, Azam comfortably nudges it through to deep mid-wicket for one.
Another front foot defense from Imad Wasim brings an end to a tight over from Dananjaya.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning a touch after pitching on middle and off, worked away to mid-wicket by coming half-forward.
Full in length again, on middle and off, Wasim meets it with a straight bat.
Changes the angle and comes from around the wicket, it's floated right up there, Imad with a solid front foot defense.
Spinning in sharply on middle stump, Azam goes deep inside his crease and flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Imad Wasim is the next batsman in. Meanwhile, Akila Dananjaya to roll his arm over now. Good time for the youngster to bowl. He will enjoy bowling on this track.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! The skipper is gone. This is a big wicket from a big player. Sri Lanka right on top, continuing their domination. Fired full and well outside off, Sarfraz goes chasing after it, attempting to drive it through the covers. Ends up getting an inside edge back onto his stumps and that's the end of his short stay. Soft dismissal, really. Can't get out to such deliveries, especially in such situations.
Beats the fielder this time. Ahmed drives it past Chandimal at mid on and gets a couple of runs to his name.
Fullish in length again, nurdled down towards mid on. Dot ball.
Length delivery outside the line of off stump, Sarfraz defends it down beside him with a straight blade.
Once again it's attacking the stumps, it's punched down towards mid on this time, for no run though.
Fuller length delivery on the stumps, fraction straight in line, Babar flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Nervy moment! Slips in the wrong one at a quicker pace, Ahmed looks to whip it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads. That could have easily crashed into the stumps.
Full toss, Ahmed fails to capitalize on it as he clips it off the bottom half to mid-wicket.
Milks this one to wide long off to rotate strike.
Ahmed comes forward and plays it with the spin to long off for a run.
Full toss on off, driven to mid off for a run.
Wrong one on leg stump, helped past mid-wicket for a run.
Ahmed dabs this one to third man for a run.
Floated outside off, stroked to covers.
Almost a wicket! Fullish delivery outside off, swinging away. Ahmed goes for a lazy drive but gets beaten all ends up. He was really close to edging it.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Back of a length outside off, cut to point.
Sarfraz Ahmed walks into the middle next.

OUT! Malik departs after a promising start! A tame dismissal really. A touch short in length delivery around off, Malik goes for a square cut but it is too close to his body for that shot. He ends up getting a faint nick and pays the price for it. Dickwella behind the stumps does the rest. The visitors continue to chip away at the wickets.
Malik makes room and places it to sweeper cover for a run.
Floated outside off, pushed to covers.
Short outside off, cut past the diving fielder at cover-point to rotate strike.
Wrong one on middle, Azam lunges forward in defense.
Floated around off, eased to mid off.
Fullish outside off, slapped to short cover where the fielder dives to his left to make a good stop.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Azam flat-bats it to long on for a run.
Short delivery on off, sticks on the pitch a bit. Azam pulls it over mid-wicket for a brace.
Change of pace again. Fuller in length outside off, pushed to covers.
Similar length delivery on middle, tucked towards wide mid on. The short mid-wicket fielder dives to his left to intercept.
Off-cutter around off, played with soft hands back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, Azam punches it to mid on.
Thisara Perera to have a burst now.

Time for Drinks. It has been a good first hour for Sri Lanka. They have bowled with discipline to reap the rewards on this slow track. Pakistan need to re-build their innings. The pair of Azam and Malik will give them assurance. They stitched a 139-run stand in the last game. A similar sort of partnership is the need of the hour for them.
Fullish delivery, eased to long on for a run.
Wrong one around the pads, Malik turns it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Malik is in really good form! Bends to the shorter delivery again and places it behind point for a boundary.
A fraction short this time, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
In line of the stumps this time, defended solidly off the front foot.
Flighted outside off, driven with the spin to sweeper cover for a run.
Angling into the batsman, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a run and Malik will retain strike.
Good running! Azam shuffles across to this one and taps it to wide mid on for a brisk single.
Short and room on offer, cut to deep cover-point for a run.
Length delivery around off, Malik puts a confident stride forward and blocks it.
Back of a length delivery on off, Shoaib hops back and defends it besides the pitch on the leg side.

Short delivery in line of the stumps, Malik rises with the bounce and does well to keep it out. This is really good commitment from Gamage. In such heat, he is bending his back and is bowling his heart out in this long spell.
Straight on this occasion, turned to short fine leg.
FOUR! There is very little margin for error against such a class player. Quicker and shorter outside off, Azam rocks back and cuts it behind point to pick up a boundary.
Slow through the air on off, Azam comes forward and blocks it.
Malik leans forward and plays it with the spin through covers. A run taken.
Tossed up outside off, Azam eases it to sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Floated around off, eased past the left side of Vandersay for a run.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes into the attack. He was decent in the last game. Can he continue to keep the pressure on?
Length delivery well outside off, stays very low. Azam doesn't bother to play at it.
Short of a length on off, Azam mistimes his pull to mid on.
Back of a length outside off,  Babar punches it elegantly to sweeper cover and hares back for the second.

FOUR! Delightful! That was not a bad ball at all. Good length ball around off, Azam covers the line and strokes it on the up down the ground. Gets it past mid on and the ball rolls away to the fence on this slow outfield.
Wide! Gamage loses his radar and sprays it down the leg side. Azam fails to play it across.
Fractionally overpitched around off, timed nicely to mid off.
Another short delivery around off, Azam sits under the bumper.
Well-directed bouncer on middle and leg, Malik ducks under it.
Malik hangs back and defends the length delivery nicely.
Short leg in place now.
Similar ball outside off, driven through covers to rotate strike.
Fuller this time, Azam lunges forward in defense.
Length ball outside off, placed to deep point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Maximum of four fielders will be allowed outside the circle. Meanwhile, Shoaib Malik comes out to bat. He was brilliant in the last game and Pakistan need him to rise to the occasion.

OUT! Gamage bounces back in style after being hit for a maximum! Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, stays a bit low and seams away after pitching. Hafeez shuffles across and feels for it but gets an outside edge. Dickwella moves to his right and takes a regulation catch. Big smiles on the faces of the Lankan players. They are dominating proceedings.
SIX! What a brilliant hit! On a length outside off, Hafeez uses his feet and lifts it over long off for a maximum. That was clean as a whistle. First one of the innings.
Fuller in length this time, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
In the zone outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery swinging in, Azam whips it past short mid-wicket. As the batsmen go for the third run, the bat slips out of Babar's hand. He is able to complete it nonetheless.
Straight on this occasion, tucked off the pads to fine leg for a run.
On a length around off, Azam mistimes his punch to covers.
Back of a length outside off, Azam looks to force it through the off side but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper.
Outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a run.
Fullish on off, eased to mid off.

In the air... but safe! Length delivery well outside off, Azam goes for a drive with minimal foot movement but gets an outside edge that flies through the vacant gully region. A run taken. Russel Arnold on-air says that the track is really slow and as a result, false shots are getting induced.
Driven to the covers by the batsman.
On middle and leg, nudged to square leg. Another tidy over, only a single from it.
Length delivery outside off, Babar places it to cover-point where a slight fumble allows the batsmen to cross over.
Angling in from outside off, Babar covers the line to block it right under his eyes.
In the zone of apprehension, Azam goes for another punch but mistimes it to mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, holding its line. Pushed off the back foot to extra cover.
Very full on off, driven sweetly to mid on.
Fullish delivery outside off, played with soft hands to the same region.
Hangs back to the good length delivery and answers it with a straight bat.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
Mohammad Hafeez is the new man in. He played a terrific knock in the last game. Can he steady the ship for Pakistan?

OUT! Shehzad throws his wicket away! Good length delivery wide outside off, Ahmed goes for a drive but hits it straight towards Siriwardana at point. He crouches and pouches it safely. The opener once again disappoints. Pakistan struggling at the moment, they are finding run-scoring difficult on this track.
Fullish ball around off, Shehzad goes for an expansive drive but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Angling into the hips, tucked through square leg. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
A tad fuller this time, Azam puts his head down and defends it calmly.
FOUR! Sublime! Fuller in length wide outside off, Azam frees his arms and creams it through covers to find the fence. First boundary for Babar.
Back of a length ball on off, skids through the surface. Babar is hurried a touch as he mistimes his pull to mid on.
In the corridor of uncertainty, punched firmly off the back foot to short cover.
Shortish delivery and room on offer, slapped to deep point for a run this time.
Length delivery outside off, Shehzad places it past point for a brace.
Another example of the slow nature of the track. Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azam mistimes his drive to mid on.
Similar length delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish in length this time, Ahmed eases it off the inner half to wide mid on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Half-volley outside off, Ahmed extends his arms and creams it to the man at covers. He is not being able to find the gaps.
Fullish delivery on middle, Shehzad lunges forward in defense.
Fuller in length on off, Azam puts his head down and with a high elbow defends it solidly. A brilliant over from Gamage, a wicket and a run from the over.
Angling in sharply into Azam, tucked to mid-wicket this time.
Outside off, driven to covers.
The centurion of the last game who turned 23 yesterday, Babar Azam strides out to bat.

OUT! Gamage draws first blood! On a length on leg stump, Zaman looks to clip it through mid-wicket but closes his bat face early. A bit of a nibble in the air induces the leading edge. The ball flies towards Kusal Mendis at wide first slip who is alert and takes a fine reverse cup catch moving to his left. Lahiru is absolutely pumped up! Just the start Sri Lanka wanted.
Length delivery this time, angling into Shehzad. He hops and tucks it through square leg to rotate strike.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven hard to covers.

FOUR! Shot! Fullish delivery on off, Zaman punches it towards Lakmal who gets his fingertips to it but the ball still rolls past mid on. The fielder from the same region gives it a chase but only comes second best. That was hit really well.
Shehzad is finally underway after 16 balls in the series. He got dismissed for a 12-ball duck in the last game. Similar ball outside off, Shehzad strokes it to extra cover for a brisk run.
Good shot for no run! Fuller length ball outside off, Ahmed drives it crisply but finds the man at covers.
Leg bye! Lakmal comes around the wicket and angles it in. Fakhar again goes for a flick but misses. The ball kisses his pads and rolls to square leg. A run taken.
Stays back to the good length delivery and defends it stoutly.
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Fakhar tries to play it across but fails to connect.
FOUR! Elegant! Length and width on offer, Zaman leans ahead and drives it on the up through extra cover to find the fence. That was all about timing and grace.
Fullish delivery on middle, Zaman works it to mid on and sets off for a run. There is a shy at the bowler's end which misses. A tight run taken.
First runs off the bat! In line of the stumps, Zaman again pushes at it hard but gets a thick inside edge through square leg. A couple taken.
Fakhar is struggling at the moment. Fuller length delivery around off, Zaman goes for an expansive drive but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Zaman mistimes his flick to mid-wicket.
On a length, slanting across the southpaw. He punches it with the angle to covers.
Fullish delivery on off, patted towards mid on.
Lahiru Gamage to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place for him as well.
Very full delivery attacking the base of middle stump, Ahmed digs it out to Lakmal who throws it back to the keeper. A tidy start from him.
A bit fuller this time, swinging in from just outside off. Shehzad covers the line and blocks it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ahmed goes at it with hard hands but mistimes it in the same region.

Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, a bit of nibble in the air. Shehzad camps back and eases it to covers. Remember, he went for a duck in the last game. He will be itching to get off the mark.
Leg bye! On leg stump, Zaman goes for a clip but misses. The ball brushes his pads and rolls to square leg. A run taken.
Loose shot! Similar length delivery in line of the stumps, swinging in. Fakhar makes room and swings at it wildly but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Wide! Movement straightaway. Lakmal starts off with a full ball around the pads, swinging further down. Zaman aims to flick it away but misses.

We are set to get underway. The players and the umpires make their way out to the middle. Ahmed Shehzad and Fakhar Zaman to open the batting for Pakistan. Suranga Lakmal to take the first new ball for Sri Lanka. Two slips and a gully in place.

Toss - Pakistan win the toss and opt to bat. Both sides remain unchanged. A bit of insight into how the track is expected to play - Like a typical UAE wicket, it will slow down as the game progresses. It will be good for strokeplay initially.

On the other hand, the tourists have had a horrid time in the limited-overs format. They have lost 8 matches on the trot. Massive improvement in all departments is the need of the hour if they are to lead a fightback. Their young star, Kusal Mendis needs to rise to the occasion. Expect a cracker!

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Abu Dhabi. The home side came back with a bang in the first game after a 2-0 defeat in the Test series. It was a complete performance from them proving that they can be ominous on their day. They are on a roll at the moment, having won their last five matches in this format.
